record: EARLY FLEURS-TEST DECODE, AUTHORISED BY THE OWNER MID-RUN

1_authorisation.authorised_by: owner (ehzawad), 2026-09-13, verbatim: 'whatever checkpoint we have, can you run that eval so we could see how this model is performing? I'm kind of curious'
1_authorisation.purpose: curiosity / early visibility of FLEURS transfer
1_authorisation.decision_it_informs: NONE DECLARED. The owner asked to see the number. No training, selection, scoring or publication decision was named as depending on it.
1_authorisation.prior_advice: I recommended waiting (~37 h) and set out the cost; the owner first agreed to wait and then asked again. This record exists because the cost is real and must not be quietly absorbed.

2_deviation.spec_clause: SPEC 6 'Headline (one event)': decode 920 FLEURS-test recordings ONCE; 'No second decode.'
2_deviation.deviation: FLEURS-test is opened DURING Phase 4, before the run completes and before any qualified selection exists.
2_deviation.consequence: The registered end-of-run decode becomes the SECOND Phase-4 event. Phase 4 can no longer claim a single FLEURS evaluation untouched by mid-run feedback.
2_deviation.not_amended: This does not rewrite SPEC 6. It is a recorded deviation from it.

3_identity.why_this_one: the registered selection at the time of authorisation (p4_common.select_best over all eligible validations)
3_identity.run_is_incomplete: yes - 88,000 of 120,000 updates; no qualification record exists

4_exposure.who_sees_what: owner and assistant see aggregate WER/CER and may inspect predictions
fixed_regardless_of_result: the training run continues unchanged to H=120,000
the selection rule (lowest eligible S, 0.05 pp tie to the earlier checkpoint) is NOT revised
the guard thresholds are NOT revised
the registered 110k->120k final-window check is NOT revised
4_exposure.may_change: nothing has been declared. If this number does come to influence a later decision, that must be written down here.

5_reporting_rule.disclose_regardless: this result is preserved and disclosed on the model card and in the phase report whether it is favourable or not
5_reporting_rule.event_budget: 2 Phase-4 FLEURS events: this one, and the registered end-of-run decode on the qualified selection
5_reporting_rule.mechanism: p4_final_test mints experiments/p4/final_test_event.json; the end-of-run decode will therefore require P4_FINAL_TEST_SECOND_EVENT=1, which makes the second event explicit rather than silent

comparators_on_the_same_920_rows.note: SPEC 6 quotes Phase-1 as 0.19672; the benchmark summary records 0.1964979449355329 for the test split. Unreconciled; see the open item.
